summary: Gold X2 Mining Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 8, 2026 news release reporting Phase 1 drilling results at the Span Prospect near its Moss Gold Project in Northwest Ontario. The 11-hole, 4,581m campaign returned headline intercepts including 40.4m at 2.05 g/t Au from 343.6m, indicating a possible northeast extension of the Moss Deposit. No transaction, offer, capital event, or management change is disclosed. The filing is operational exploration disclosure, not a special situation; no board recommendation or advisor is referenced. Nothing to arbitrage.
